source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Judges 6–12 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 230 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Preserve martial strength and both parents without shifting stigma into narrator abuse.
Keep exclusion, inheritance and the brothers’ stated reason as their speech.
Retain his charge against the elders without correcting it to brothers alone.
Retain contested claim and all three river limits as royal speech.
Keep formal introduction and explicit denial naming both peoples.
Keep both refusals as given in Jephthah’s retelling, without harmonizing other travel accounts.
Keep divine-gift argument and conquest in the speaker’s voice.
Keep challenge and dispossession argument without endorsing it as modern land policy.
Retain Chemosh in an address to Ammon’s king and the parallel divine-possession claims; note relationship and wording ambiguity.
Keep both rhetorical questions and Jephthah’s version of Balak’s actions.
Preserve exact duration and both town groups without chronological recalculation.
Keep reciprocal wrong and judge repetition as the closing appeal.
Keep Spirit before the vow and the repeated route without making the vow divinely commanded.
Keep emphatic conditional vow and Jephthah as its initiator.
Retain personal encounter, peace, dedication and sacrifice linked by and; note whatever and alternative reading without erasing force.
Preserve every place, twenty towns and extent of defeat.
Keep matching came-out-to-meet language, celebration and double statement of only child.
Preserve his distress and blame as his speech, not a narrator judgment on the daughter.
Keep her actual reply, mouth repetition and vengeance interpretation without adding consent language.
Keep two months, female companions and virginity as the object of lament; note unusual descent wording.
Retain the permission and repeated lament without replacing her loss with a modern diagnosis.
Retain the restrained report of fulfillment and sexual inexperience, neither adding execution details nor replacing sacrifice with lifelong service.
Retain female remembrance, unnamed daughter and four-day annual custom; note lament/commemorate range.
